response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT actor_id, COUNT(*) AS film_count FROM film_actor GROUP BY actor_id), t AS (SELECT c.actor_id, c.film_count, CAST(c.film_count AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM film_actor) AS share FROM c) SELECT actor_id, film_count, share, share - (SELECT AVG(share) FROM t) AS diff_from_avg FROM t ORDER BY diff_from_avg DESC LIMIT 10
